notes.title: Demo Update: Codex & Options Tweaks
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone! We’ve got an update for the demo today: [/p][list][*][p][b]New Options: [/b][/p][list][*][p]Added option for audio description mode[/p][/*][*][p]Added option for codex entry unlock notifications [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]UI Improvements: [/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated codex UI [/p][/*][*][p]The codex can now be opened during gameplay (so you can read while you read)[/p][/*][*][p]Added new section for character close-ups in the CG gallery [/p][/*][*][p]Keyboard navigation[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Misc: [/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated some CGs/closeups[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some typos [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🎺 👻 [i]Haunted Trumpet[/i][/p]
